Core Capabilities

Services We Offer

End-to-end multimodal freight forwarding and regulatory customs clearance tailored for UAE and international trade lanes.

Sea Freight

FCL & LCL

Cost-effective ocean shipping connecting Jebel Ali and Port Rashid with major global ports. Flexible Full Container Load (20ft/40ft/HC), Less than Container Load (LCL) consolidation, and breakbulk cargo handling.

  • Port-to-Port & Door-to-Door Ocean Freight
  • Reefer, Out-of-Gauge & Project Cargo
  • Bill of Lading & Marine Documentation

Air Freight

Express & Charter

Time-critical air cargo solutions operating through Dubai International (DXB) and Al Maktoum International (DWC) hubs, ensuring rapid transit for high-value, perishable, and urgent commercial shipments.

  • Priority Next-Flight-Out & Consolidated Air
  • Sea-Air Multimodal Connections via Dubai
  • Air Waybill (AWB) & Dangerous Goods Handling

Road Transport

UAE & GCC

Reliable Full Truckload (FTL) and Less than Truckload (LTL) overland fleets serving all seven Emirates and cross-border GCC corridors (Saudi Arabia, Oman, Kuwait, Bahrain, and Qatar).

  • Port-to-Warehouse Container Haulage
  • Cross-Border GCC Bonded Trucking
  • Flatbed, Curtainsider & Reefer Trailers

Customs Clearance

Dubai Trade

Fast, compliant customs brokerage across UAE sea ports, air cargo terminals, and land borders—minimizing demurrage and accelerating cargo release for importers and exporters.

  • Import, Export & Transit Declarations
  • HS Code Classification & Duty Advisory
  • Municipality, MOIAT & Chamber Attestations

Unified Freight & Trade

Seamless coordination between wholesale procurement and international freight brokerage under a single group umbrella.

Regulatory Precision

Proactive HS classification, pre-arrival customs filing, and full UAE statutory compliance to keep cargo moving without delays.

Strategic Dubai Hubs

Positioned in Dubai Investment Park First (near Jebel Ali & DWC) and Al Qusais Industrial Area 1 for rapid port and city access.
